versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Crypto Snapshot Pro.
- Provides AI-powered crypto trading signals with LONG/SHORT/HOLD recommendations.
- Includes entry, target, and stop-loss levels, conviction indicator, and AI-generated market commentary.
- Utilizes technical indicators such as RSI, EMA, MACD, and Bollinger Bands.
- Supports more than 500 Binance USDT trading pairs.
- Requires payment in USDC on Base network prior to receiving signals.
